title: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
title_en: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
author: Wired AI
content_snippet: Anne Le Hananff, France’s minister of digital affairs, convened representatives from social media firms on Tuesday for an emergency meeting, after their platforms were blamed for fanning the flames of the worst civil unrest the country has seen in years. The goal of the meeting was to remind platforms that they need to moderate content on their sites, including livestream video, to avoid violent content or anything that could encourage people to break the imposed curfew, according to French TV s
summary_en: France's digital affairs ministry convened an emergency crisis meeting with executives from major social media networks amid the country's worst civil unrest in years. Officials demanded strict content moderation and live-stream curbs, warning that manipulated and AI-generated protest videos are amplifying real-world blockades and curfew violations.

title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
title_en: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
Mistral AI launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system combines speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and a voice agent SDK, supports more than 50 languages, and lets agents tap into external tools during live conversations. It can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control.

title: OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran

author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:

title_en: Cloudflare's Clairic pulls data from documents faster and cheaper than LLMs
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:

summary_en: Cloudflare has introduced Clairic, a specialized AI extraction model available in preview on Workers AI with open weights coming soon. title: Google Cloud Outage Takes Down Revolut and Other Banks in UK
title_en: Google Cloud Outage Takes Down Revolut and Other Banks in UK
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: An outage at Google Cloud knocked out banking services in the UK including Revolut Ltd. early on Tuesday.
summary_en: Google Cloud's London infrastructure region suffered a widespread service disruption beginning late Monday, triggering outages across multiple enterprise clients in the UK. The incident notably incapacitated core banking and transaction processing systems for fintech unicorn Revolut, leaving millions of mobile banking customers unable to access accounts or complete transfers. The severe breakdown underscores the architectural vulnerability of modern fintech platforms relying on single-provider cloud infrastructures without resilient multi-region failovers.

title: Anthropic's leaked federal AI bill draws widespread criticism from AI safety advocates for being significantly weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act (Shakeel Hashim/Transformer)
title_en: Anthropic's leaked federal AI bill draws widespread criticism from AI safety advocates for being significantly weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act (Shakeel Hashim/Transformer)
author: Transformer
content_snippet: A leaked discussion draft of a federal AI bill which Anthropic has been circulating to lawmakers, published by Politico on Friday, makes that safety-first pitch ring hollow. The bill, which has been widely criticized by AI safety advocates, is much weaker than the Obernolte/Trahan FRONTIER Act, and arguably makes it legally harder to prevent a dangerous AI model from being released than it is today. It reads like Anthropic’s business interests winning out over its purported safety concerns. And
summary_en: A leaked draft of a federal AI legislative proposal crafted and privately circulated by Anthropic to U.S. lawmakers has ignited fierce backlash from safety advocates. The proposed legislation proves far weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act by omitting licensing benchmarks for third-party auditing bodies, tolerating self-certification, and complicating state authorities' power to halt hazardous releases. The move reflects Anthropic's quiet commercial pivot to preempt aggressive federal safety curbs with corporate-friendly guardrails under the banner of responsible innovation.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 以“安全第一”为品牌基石的AI领军企业Anthropic，其秘密游说国会议员的联邦人工智能法案草案遭媒体泄露曝光。该草案内容显著弱于跨党派支持的《前沿法案》（FRONTIER Act），不仅未设定第三方安全评估机构的法定准入与牌照标准、允许评估机构自证合规，甚至在法律层面变相削弱了政府阻止高危危险模型发布的干预权。此举动因在于Anthropic试图借国会政策窗口期，以自我设定的温和规范抢先替代潜在的严厉硬性监管，为自身未来商业化模型扫清上市障碍。

title: Sources: Waymo aims to expand its fleet to 8K by the end of this year, up from 4K today, and to 20K by the end of 2027, after raising $5B in debt this month (Ellen DiMauro/Semafor)
title_en: Sources: Waymo aims to expand its fleet to 8K by the end of this year, up from 4K today, and to 20K by the end of 2027, after raising $5B in debt this month (Ellen DiMauro/Semafor)
author: Semafor
content_snippet:
As Waymo expands into new cities with its self-driving cars, the company plans to use the $5 billion it recently borrowed to massively increase its fleet.

The company, which currently has 4,000 cars, is looking to bring its total number to 8,000 by the end of the year and grow to 20,000 by the end of next year, according to people familiar with the matter.

Waymo declined to comment. The company said in a statement on its website that it raised the funds to grow internationally and in the US.
summary_en: Waymo has raised $5 billion in debt from private credit lenders without parent guarantees from Alphabet, outlining a hyper-aggressive fleet expansion targeting 8,000 vehicles by year-end (up from 4,000) and 20,000 by 2027. Operating across 15 cities and expanding to international hubs like Toronto, the company is sourcing custom electric vehicles from Zeekr to drive down unit costs while planning fleet lease securitizations to cement a self-sustaining asset-heavy mobility business.

title: Amazon launches TorchNeuron, an open-source framework that lets developers run PyTorch code on Amazon's Trainium chips with no rewriting needed, in public beta (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
title_en: Amazon launches TorchNeuron, an open-source framework that lets developers run PyTorch code on Amazon's Trainium chips with no rewriting needed, in public beta (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
author: GeekWire
content_snippet: A new software tool from Amazon aims to make switching from Nvidia to the company's own AI chips about as simple as changing a setting.
summary_en: Amazon has launched a public beta for TorchNeuron, an open-source framework designed to lower barriers for developers. The tool enables PyTorch code to run directly on Amazon's proprietary Trainium chips without requiring code rewrites.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】亚马逊（Amazon）与开发者社区：发布开源框架TorchNeuron公测版，实现PyTorch代码在Trainium芯片上的零重写运行
【起因与机理】打破英伟达生态壁垒，吸引开发者从英伟达GPU迁移至亚马逊自研AI芯片
【关键技术规格】亚马逊发布TorchNeuron开源框架公测版。
【行业影响与走向】旨在加速去英伟达化，争夺AI基础设施市场。

[Root Cause & Mechanism] To break Nvidia's software lock-in and entice developers to migrate from Nvidia GPUs to Amazon's custom silicon
[Key Technical Spec] Amazon launched TorchNeuron open-source public beta.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Aims to accelerate anti-Nvidia migration and capture AI infrastructure market share.
